parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The probability density function of the random variable $X$ is given by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} kx(4-x) & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 2, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $k$ is a constant.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The random variable $Y$ has the following properties.

• $Y$ takes values between 0 and 5 only.

• The probability density function of $Y$ is symmetrical.

Given that $\text{P}(Y < a) = 0.2$, find $\text{P}(2.5 < Y < 5 - a)$ illustrating your method with a sketch on the axes provided.
